name: Prompt Box
description: The message box for a chat with an agent: a text area that grows line by line, a model picker, and a send button that turns into stop while a reply streams.

props.name: value
props.description: The text (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled; the composer then clears itself after sending.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting text when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called as the text changes.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the text when the send button is pressed or Enter is typed. Shift+Enter adds a line, and Enter that confirms an input-method candidate is ignored.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the stop button is pressed while streaming.

props.name: status
props.description: While streaming, the send arrow morphs into a stop square and Enter no longer sends.

props.name: models
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Models for the picker in the toolbar. The picker is hidden when there are none.

props.name: model
props.description: The chosen model id (controlled). Use defaultModel when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Starting model when uncontrolled.

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: Called when a model is chosen.

props.name: context
props.type: { id?: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Quiet chips under the box, such as a branch and a folder.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the text area.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called with the files chosen after pressing the + button, which opens the system file picker.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types the picker offers, as MIME types or extensions.

props.name: showAttach
props.description: Shows the + button.

props.name: canSend
props.description: Overrides whether sending is allowed. By default the send button is disabled while the text is blank; pass true to send attachments without text.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines the text area grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables typing and every control.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the text area on mount.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered inside the box above the text area, for attachments.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are spread onto it.

props.name: value
props.description: The text (controlled). Also accepts defaultValue, onChange, isDisabled and every other prop of the react-aria-components TextField.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on Enter without Shift.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Lines shown when empty.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines it grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the element that clips and animates the height.

props.name: textAreaClassName
props.description: Classes for the textarea, e.g. to change its padding.

props.name: ref
props.description: The textarea element.

props.name: status
props.description: Idle shows an up arrow; streaming morphs it into a stop square.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when pressed while idle.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when pressed while streaming.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables sending. Ignored while streaming, so stop always works.

props.name: models
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The choices, shown in a dropdown with their descriptions.

props.name: model
props.description: The chosen id (controlled).

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Starting id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: Called when a model is chosen.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the menu and prefixes the trigger's accessible name.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the trigger.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called with the files chosen in the system picker.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types the picker offers.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and tooltip.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the button.

props.name: items
props.type: { id?: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The chips, each with an optional 14 pixel icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the list.
